description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the submission is complete for its op; fetches nothing and returns no grades.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

facilitator.description: For the bazaar op: the facilitator the payload was captured from (e.g. cdp).

listing.description: The listing under check, in the op's published form (check: url, method, network, asset, price_micro; example: example_input + input_schema; promise: max_timeout_seconds + declared_delivery_seconds).

payload.description: For the bazaar op: the captured payment payload carrying resource + extensions.bazaar.

name: listing_check_precheck
